about: Hello! I'm Lynn, a software engineer passionate about building innovative human experiences and exploring the intersectionality between technology and art. I am a UCSD graduate with a strong interest in machine learning, computer vision, and computer graphics. Currently, I am an engineer developing 8th Wall's AR based 3D game engine, and previously, I have worked at UCSD's HXI lab creating human interactive experiences for healthcare systems. I have also made a couple games for game jams and tinkered with robots, apps, and other random systems.

In my free time, I enjoy taking on challenges, piecing together puzzles (literally), and playing games (mostly RPGs). I have a keen interest in learning about local plants and ecological conservation through gardening and contributing to iNaturalist. I also like taking up many hobbies and crafts including drawing, knitting, crocheting, photography, and glassblowing.
This website was built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. Source code is available on my GitHub.

Reduced by half the memory load of AR features into smaller developer loadable WASM components
Designed and built the backend pipeline of the audio system for game engine natively supported across multiple platforms
Empowered the team by leading interviews, reviewing code, and mentoring interns to ship production-ready code
